buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address Commandant 92 Base Hospital Badami Bagh Contt Srinagar PIN-190004 . 2. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of B V Rao A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of 1.5 Ton Split Air Conditioner (Note: The heading says 1. 5 Ton here, while the undertaking sheet in Image 2 references 2 Ton) * 1. Technical Compliance: The bidder shall offer a 1.5 Ton Split Air Conditioner strictly in accordance wi th the technical specification[s] mentioned in the GeM bid and applicable standards. * 2. Manufacturer Authorization Certificate: The bidder shall submit a valid Manufacturer Authorizati on Form (MAF), wherever required under the bid [c]onditions, issued by the Original Equipment Manufactu

rer (OEM). * 3. Technical Documents: The bidder shall upload the technical datasheet, product catalogue and rele vant certificates of the offer[ed] model along with the technical bid, wherever required. The offered produc t must meet the specification[s]. *4. Accessories: The quoted price shall include the following accessories: * Insulated copper refrigerant piping, minimum 3 metres. * Interconnecting cable and necessary electrical connections. * Condensate drain pipe. * Indoor and outdoor unit mounting arrangements. * Wireless remote control with batteries. * Standard installation materials and necessary fasteners. * 5. Installation and Commissioning: The successful bidder shall carry out complete installation, testin g and commissioning of the AC at the con[s]ignee's location. The cost of standard installation and commiss ioning shall be included in the quoted price. * 6. Warranty: The AC shall carry a minimum one-year comprehensive warranty and a minimum ten-year compressor war[r]anty, subject to the applicable GeM category provisions and OEM warranty terms. The w arranty shall com[m]ence from the date of successful installation, commissioning and acceptance. * 7. Delivery: The successful bidder shall deliver the equipment to the consignee's location within the deli very period spe[c]ified in the GeM bid. * 8. Inspection and Acceptance: The supplied AC shall be inspected by the consignee or an officer nom inated by the competent authority. The equipment shall be accepted only after verification of specification s, accessories and satisfactory insta[l]lation and commissioning. * 9. Replacement of Defective Equipment: Any equipment found damaged, defective or not conformi ng to the specifications shall be replaced by the supplier at no additional cost to the buyer, in accordance with the applicable contractual provisions. * 10. After-Sales Service: The bidder shall provide details of the authorised service centre and service c ontact information for warran[t]y-related complaints. * 11. Rejection of Bid: Bids that fail to meet the mandatory technical specifications or do not submit the documents specifically re[q]uired under the bid conditions shall be dealt with in accordance with the applic able GeM terms and condit[i]ons. * 12. General Conditions: All other terms and conditions shall be governed by the applicable GeM Gener al Terms and Conditions (GT[C]), Special Terms and Conditions (STC), and the provisions of the bid. . 5. Certificates The bidder is required to upload, along with the bid, all relevant certificates such as BIS licence, type test certificate, approval certificates and other certificates as prescribed in the Product Specification given in the bid document.
